edits.new:
The six texts are copied from RWB-E1-018 and the Error and Message Standard v4, and this story adds no message ID. For MSG-P3-027 the {table} value names the package code only and the {check} value is "package in force".

While v_ace_batch_status does not exist, the batch gate answers as for an incomplete batch: 409 with MSG-P1-001, no candidate and no break row. DP01 is never stamped LOADED for that date, so the case creation job creates no case for it. The gate is read from the view only and is never inferred from data_as_of, a row count or a file. The refusal status 409 and the two filled fields of MSG-P1-001 are fixed in the published contract and settled in ASM-B-P1-07-E1018-4.
